parent_time_series_id.title: Parent time series ID
parent_time_series_id.description:
A unique identifier representing a single time series. This corresponds to the `id` field in the `time-series-metadata` endpoint.
The parent_time_series_id returns statistics tied to a particular database entry

Accepts Multiple Values:
Multiple USGS Parent Time Series Identifiers can be specified

Default Behavior:
If no parent time series identifier is supplied, then all records matching the rest of the provided criteria will be returned.

Examples:
Return statistics tied to one particular database entry
- &parent_time_series_id=db020040c1b746c2a635f5a53a6bb904
Return statistics tied to multiple database entries
- &parent_time_series_id=db020040c1b746c2a635f5a53a6bb9045&parent_time_series_id=db020040c1b746c2a635f5a53a6bb904

monitoring_location_id.title: Monitoring location ID
monitoring_location_id.description:
A unique identifier representing a single monitoring location. This corresponds to the `id` field in the `monitoring-locations` endpoint. Monitoring location IDs are created by combining the agency code of the agency responsible for the monitoring location (e.g. USGS) with the ID number of the monitoring location (e.g. 02238500), separated by a hyphen (e.g. USGS-02238500).
Each monitoring location has been assigned a unique station number that places them in downstream order

Monitoring Location Identifiers can be found using this period of record
Accepts Multiple Values:
Multiple Monitoring Location Identifiers can be specified

Default Behavior:
If a monitoring location identifier is not supplied, then statistics will be returned for all monitoring location identifiers within the period of record

Examples:
Return statistics from a single monitoring location
- &monitoring_location_id=USGS-01432160
Return statistics from multiple monitoring locations
- &monitoring_location_id=USGS-01432160&monitoring_location_id=USGS-01432161

monitoring_location_number.title: Monitoring location number
monitoring_location_number.description:
An identifier representing a single monitoring location. This corresponds to the `number` field in the `monitoring-locations` endpoint. Monitoring location numbers (e.g. 02238500).
Each monitoring location has been assigned a unique station number that places them in downstream order

Monitoring Location Numbers can be found using this period of record
Accepts Multiple Values:
Multiple Monitoring Location Numbers can be specified

Default Behavior:
If a monitoring location number is not supplied, then statistics will be returned for all monitoring location numbers within the period of record

Examples:
Return statistics from a single monitoring location
- &monitoring_location_number=01432160
Return statistics from multiple monitoring locations
- &monitoring_location_number=01432160&monitoring_location_number=01432161

agency_code.title: Agency code
agency_code.description: The agency that is reporting the data. Agency codes are fixed values assigned by the National Water Information System (NWIS). A list of agency codes is available at [https://api.waterdata.usgs.gov/ogcapi/v0/collections/agency-codes/items](https://api.waterdata.usgs.gov/ogcapi/v0/collections/agency-codes/items).

parameter_code.title: Parameter code
parameter_code.description:
Parameter codes are 5-digit codes used to identify the constituent measured and the units of measure. A complete list of parameter codes and associated groupings can be found at [https://api.waterdata.usgs.gov/ogcapi/v0/collections/parameter-codes/items](https://api.waterdata.usgs.gov/ogcapi/v0/collections/parameter-codes/items).
Accepts Multiple Values:
Multiple USGS parameter codes can be specified

Default Behavior:
If no USGS parameter code is specified, but a Monitoring Location Identifier is supplied, then all statistics and their parameter codes with a matching monitoring location identifier will be returned. All statistics within the period of record will be returned if no parameter code or monitoring location identifier are specified.

Examples:
Return statistics from one matching USGS parameter code
- &parameter_code=00095
Return statistics from multiple matching USGS parameter codes
- &parameter_code=00095&parameter_code=0009

approval_status.title: Approval Status
approval_status.description:
Whether to include approved and/or provisional observations. At this time, only approved observations are returned.
Accepts Multiple Values:Multiple approval_status values can be specified as separate parameter-value pairs.
Default Behavior: Approved observations are included by default.
Example: Only include approved observations
- &approval_status=approved
Available values: approved

country_code.title: Country code
country_code.description:
If one of country, county, or state code is supplied then the other two arguments do not need to be specified
Accepts Multiple Values:
Multiple Country codes can be specified

Default Behavior:
US will be specified by default.

Examples:
Return statics from one country
- &country_code=US
Return statistics from multiple countries
- &country_code=US&country_code=CA

state_code.title: State code
state_code.description:
State code. A [two-digit ANSI code](https://www2.census.gov/geo/docs/reference/state.txt) (formerly FIPS code) as defined by the American National Standards Institute, to define States and equivalents. A three-digit ANSI code is used to define counties and county equivalents. [A lookup table is available.](https://www.census.gov/library/reference/code-lists/ansi.html#states) The only countries with political subdivisions other than the US are Mexico and Canada. The Mexican states have US state codes ranging from 81-86 and Canadian provinces have state codes ranging from 90-98.
Accepts Multiple Values:
Multiple State codes can be specified

Default Behavior:
US:42 will be specified by default.

Examples:
Return statistics from one state
- &state_code=US:42
Return statistics in multiple states
- &state_code=US:42&state_code=US:36

county_code.title: County code
county_code.description:
The code for the county or county equivalent (parish, borough, etc.) in which the monitoring location is located. A list of codes is available at [https://api.waterdata.usgs.gov/ogcapi/v0/collections/counties/items](https://api.waterdata.usgs.gov/ogcapi/v0/collections/counties/items).
Accepts Multiple Values:
Multiple County codes can be specified

Default Behavior:
US:42:103 will be specified by default.

Examples:
Return statistics from one county
- &county_code=US:42:103
Return statistics from multiple counties
- &county_code=US:42:103&county_code=US:42:105

site_type_code.title: Monitoring location type code
site_type_code.description:
A code describing the hydrologic setting of the monitoring location. A list of codes is available at [https://api.waterdata.usgs.gov/ogcapi/v0/collections/site-types/items](https://api.waterdata.usgs.gov/ogcapi/v0/collections/site-types/items).
Accepts Multiple Values:
Multiple Site Type Codes can be specified

Default Behavior:
If no Site Type code is specified, statistics of all site types with the matching Monitoring Location Identifier will be returned.

Examples:
Return statistics with matching site type code
- &site_type_code=GW
Return statistics with matching site type codes
- &site_type_code=GW&site_type_code=ST

site_type_name.title: Monitoring location type
site_type_name.description:
A description of the hydrologic setting of the monitoring location. A list of codes is available at [https://api.waterdata.usgs.gov/ogcapi/v0/collections/site-types/items](https://api.waterdata.usgs.gov/ogcapi/v0/collections/site-types/items).
Accepts Multiple Values:
Multiple Site Type Names can be specified

Default Behavior:
If no Site Type name is specified, statistics of all site types with the matching Monitoring Location Identifier will be returned

Examples:
Return statistics with matching site type name
- &site_type_name=Well
Return statistics with multiple matching site type names
- &site_type_name=Well&site_type_name=Spring

computation_type.title: Desired statistical computation method
computation_type.description:
Statistical computation method
Accepts Multiple Values:
Multiple computation types can be specified

Default Behavior:
All statistical computation types are returned by default.

Examples:
Only return arithmetic_mean calculations
- &computation_type=arithmetic_mean
Only return maximum calculations
- &computation_type=maximum
Only return median calculations
- &computation_type=median
Only return minimum calculations
- &computation_type=minimum
Only return percentile calculations
- &computation_type=percentile
Return multiple calculations
- &computation_type=arithmetic_mean&computation_type=median
Available values : arithmetic_mean, maximum, median, minimum, percentile

start_date.title: Start date
start_date.description:
The logic is inclusive i.e it will also return records that match the date
Default Behavior:
If an end date is supplied, but no start date is supplied, then statistics will be supplied for the entire period of record ending with the end date. If an end date is not supplied, but a start date is supplied then statistics will be supplied for the period of record following the start date. If no start or end date are supplied then statistics will be supplied for the entire period of record.

Example:
Return statistics starting on a particular start date
- &start_date=02-04

end_date.title: End date
end_date.description:
The logic is inclusive i.e it will also return records that match the date
Default Behavior:
If an end date is supplied, but no start date is supplied, then statistics will be supplied for the entire period of record ending with the end date. If an end date is not supplied, but a start date is supplied then statistics will be supplied for the period of record following the start date. If no start or end date are supplied then statistics will be supplied for the entire period of record.

Example:
Return statistics starting on a particular start date
- &end_date=03-04

next_token.title: Token for next set of results
next_token.description:
Randomly generated token value of numbers and digits

To get all pages, one is required to make continued requests with the newly provided token until the last resulting page where no nextToken is present
Default Behavior:
Provided in the event of results exceeding the default or specified page_size.

Example:
Returned token for next set of results
- A43kJRTn26nT46fyj4ug1A

interval_type.title: Interval Type
interval_type.description:
Default Behavior:
Defaults to 'M'
Filters the results to one of the following intervals: M for month, CY for calendar year, WY for water year

Examples:
Return month interval
- &interval_type=M
Return calendar year interval
- &interval_type=CY
Return water year interval
- &interval_type=WY
Available values : M, CY, WY
